create_RolloutStorage: create a RolloutStorage instance with discount, gae_lambda, n_envs, n_eval, n_steps, action_space, obs_space, and agent parameters
reset_RolloutStorage: reset the RolloutStorage buffer to initialize empty arrays for observations, actions, rewards, dones, log_pis, values, and carry
append_rollout_transitions: append rollout transitions including obs, action, reward, done, log_pi, value, and carry to the storage buffer
compute_gae_targets: compute generalized advantage estimation and targets from value, reward, done, and last_value using discounted returns
get_batch_from_buffer: get a RolloutBatch namedtuple containing obs, actions, rewards, dones, log_pis, values, targets, advantages, and carry from the buffer
